problem.statement: Repository evidence must test diagnostic and repair behavior beyond the ten R001 JSON cases.

semantics.expected_tokens: Parser diagnostics report the exact runtime expected-token set; lexer failures have no parser state.
semantics.proposed_edit: A repository-authored source edit is evaluated separately from the bounded runtime repair plan.
semantics.fresh_reparse: Edits are applied by byte range and parsed by a newly allocated generated parser.
semantics.semantic_value_risk: Syntactic acceptance does not establish that inserted, deleted, or replaced semantic values match user intent.

trust_boundary.statement: The capture executes generated lexer and action code only from the four allowlisted repository fixtures.

limitations.statement: No external workload or reviewer is represented.
Bounded repair reports one selected plan, not every equal-cost edit.
A successful fresh parse does not prove intended program semantics.
Indentation diagnostics are excluded because no indentation contract exists.

kill_conditions.statement: Fail when a fixture or corpus digest changes without regenerated evidence.
Fail when a required H003 dimension has no case.
Fail when the normative R001 snapshot digest changes.
Fail when HOLD has a review record or a pending case has labels.
Fail when a proposed edit no longer produces its committed fresh outcome.
